task: Configure a multi-stage recommendation and deadline workflow for the 'MD Program 2026' application in SchoolStack: require three recommendation requests (two from science faculty and one from a clinical supervisor), set the recommendation submission deadline to December 15, 2025, enable automated reminder emails every 7 days for incomplete recommendations beginning December 1, 2025, and create a deadline rule that automatically moves any application still missing required items to 'Waitlist Review' after the final application deadline of January 10, 2026.
